The crisis we are addressing

Three problems. One interconnected crisis.
One approach that addresses all three.

🌱
30%

Soil & Biodiversity Collapse

Decades of chemical fertilizer use have stripped Indian farmlands of organic matter and natural fertility. The land is being farmed to exhaustion.

🍚
↑ 40%

What's Actually in Your Food

Pesticide residues in everyday staples — rice, wheat, dal — affect consumer health silently. Most food sold as "natural" lacks genuine traceability.

👨‍🌾
250M

Farmers Trapped in Debt

Chemical farming input costs keep rising while market prices stay low. Small farmers in Eastern UP earn less than minimum wage.

Our response — from the ground up

We don't source from
"natural suppliers."
We know every farmer by name.

Ecoculture began in Sant Kabir Nagar, where founder Laukesh Singh witnessed firsthand what chemical farming was doing to the land and the people who worked it.

Our model is built on Prakritik Kheti — प्राकृतिक खेती. We work directly with farmers transitioning to natural farming, giving them training, guaranteed market access, and fair prices.

No brokers. No aggregators. No vague claims. Just direct relationships — and the accountability that comes with them.

A note on honesty: We are early stage. These farmer partnerships are being built right now. We're not yet in every kitchen in Delhi — but we're building the supply chain the right way, not the fast way.
